events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Start the diagnostic and agree access
attendees: Heads of the three acquired companies
events.decision: Will each company open its sales, purchasing and finance data and staff to the team?
agenda: Present the three phases and the diagnostic in weeks 1-3
Align on the data and people needed at each company
Decide on access to sales, purchasing and finance data and staff

events.label: Go/no-go on design
events.purpose: Decide whether to go ahead with design
attendees: Heads of the three acquired companies
events.decision: Go ahead with design on the priority gaps in sales, purchasing and finance?
agenda: Present the current-state baseline for the first two companies
Review the priority gaps to Grupo Vale across three companies
Decide on going ahead with design on the priority gaps

events.label: Go/no-go on cutover
events.purpose: Decide whether to start the first cutover
attendees: Heads of the three acquired companies
events.decision: Go or no-go on moving the first company onto Grupo Vale's processes and systems?
agenda: Present target processes and system mapping, all three companies
Review the readiness checks and the integration plan decision pack
Decide on the cutover of the first company

events.label: Check-in: cutover progress
attendees: Heads of the three acquired companies
events.decision: Is cutover progress on track to start stabilization and the plan update in week 11?
agenda: Present the cutover readiness and progress report, first two areas
Discuss open issues and early results that feed the plan update
Confirm progress before stabilization and the plan update begin

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Approve the result and plan for the board
attendees: Heads of the three acquired companies
events.decision: Approve the first-company result and the integration plan to take to the board?
agenda: Present first-company results, go-live records and the updated plan
Review the open-issues log and closure record
Decide on the plan to take to the board on 29 January 2027

notes: The board's approval is a success criterion, but no board member is among the stakeholders; confirm who represents it at the final readout.
